tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONA AS PER KC-7 TENDER DOCUMENTS GST WILL BE PAID SEPARTELY TO TENDERED AMOUNT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for Award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years, i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than Rs. 2.52Lakhs issued by Government officer
Driver with Valid License certificate and supplying vehicle have latest model series above the year of Registration as 2022 and vehicle have compulsory RTO Registration and Insurance certificate
